senses.sense_definition: A dome-shaped shelter traditionally made from blocks of packed snow, built by the Inuit.

examples.text: The children had fun learning how to build an <w>igloo</w> out of the deep snow.
Inside the snow <w>igloo</w>, the air remained remarkably warm compared to the harsh wind outside.

senses.sense_definition: A hollow chamber excavated in the snow by a seal above its breathing hole in sea ice.

examples.text: The mother seal gave birth to her pup safely hidden inside a snow <w>igloo</w>.
A polar bear used its heavy paws to break through the seal's <w>igloo</w> on the frozen sea.

senses.sense_definition: A dome-shaped, reinforced concrete bunker used to store ammunition or nuclear weapons safely.

examples.text: Guards patrolled the perimeter of each reinforced <w>igloo</w> where the warheads were kept.
Engineers designed the storage <w>igloo</w> to withstand explosive blasts and extreme weather.

senses.sense_definition: A contoured rigid cargo container shaped to fit within an aircraft's fuselage.

examples.text: Ground crew loaded each aluminum <w>igloo</w> into the main deck of the freight plane.
The cargo arrived intact because the standardized <w>igloo</w> had kept the boxes secure during transport.
